reply.summary: Caeru is a half-machine, half-human student built by a scheming inventor to mimic the gifts of any hero he studies. Gifted with borrowed minds as well as borrowed powers, this young construct finally buckled under the clash of voices inside him.

feats.scene: Caeru copies a dozen borrowed gifts at once and flattens a parking structure with a single combined blast.
Caeru is hammered by a team of champions and keeps standing until his mind frays.

reply.summary: Rumrerlla is a celebrated artist and storyteller who took up a masked mantle out of admiration for a hero of his youth. Ink-stained and thoughtful, this creator fights with sketches, speeches and a stubborn sense of justice.

feats.scene: Rumrerlla swings a drawing board at a mugger and cracks it across his shoulder.
Rumrerlla takes a hard shove on a studio stairwell and gets back up.

reply.summary: Rnriani is a stubborn patrol cop whose knee never healed after being shot protecting his sibling. Chained to a desk but unbroken, this veteran insists that street smarts still count and supports his brother's work.

feats.scene: Rnriani lands a hard right on a loud suspect despite a bad leg.
Rnriani takes a punch from a larger thug and answers back.

reply.summary: Valran is a bald, soft-spoken partner in a small firm that handles odd jobs around the city. Patient and honest, this tradesman shows up on time and keeps the ledgers straight.

feats.scene: Valran hammers a stuck crate lid open with a mallet.
Valran slips on a wet dock and gets up with a laugh.

reply.summary: Ausauta is a quiet agent with lost memories who wakes in a hospital after a ship explosion. Gifted by a special suit with burning flame, this amnesiac hero slowly learns who he used to be.

feats.scene: Ausauta unleashes a roaring flame column that levels a warehouse down to its slab.
Ausauta walks through a blazing garage and steps out with a smouldering jacket.

reply.summary: Mantse is a gruff site boss who runs a crew of builders with a sharp tongue. Stern to a fault, this supervisor treats his own boy with harsh words he later regrets.

feats.scene: Mantse shoves a loaded wheelbarrow up a ramp in one go.
Mantse takes a falling plank on the shoulder and keeps barking orders.

reply.summary: Iarrni is a hulking undead brute stitched together from grave-robbed parts and summoned by a prankster's magic. Needing no food or breath, this patchwork giant pounds through walls and shrugs off blows.

feats.scene: Iarrni punches through a masonry wall and flings a bus-sized slab aside.
Iarrni stands in the path of a falling crane and the crane bends around him.

reply.summary: Lantile is a grey-haired enforcer who serves a crime boss and covets his employer's seat. Quick with a threat, this thug underpaid his men and paid for it in an alley.

feats.scene: Lantile empties a pistol at a warehouse door and splinters the frame.
Lantile is held by his own hired men and cannot break free.

reply.summary: Astma is a down-at-heel seal who once starred on the stage and now stumbles into mysteries with his clever wife. Cheerful and sturdy, this performer balances massive loads on his nose.

feats.scene: Astma tosses a stack of barrels into a truck bed without spilling a drop.
Astma takes a thrown crate on the chest and applauds himself.

reply.summary: Selata is a grey-haired national leader during a world war who gets snatched thrice by plotters. Calm in a crisis, this statesman keeps negotiating even from a locked cell.

feats.scene: Selata bangs a gavel and silences a roaring council room.
Selata sits through a bumpy seaplane flight with composure.

reply.summary: Lorliia is a friendly doorman and former star batter who hides a glorious past from his tenants. Warm and modest, this old athlete coaches a youth team and dodges attention.

feats.scene: Lorliia smacks a fastball over a distant fence with a creaky swing.
Lorliia slips on an icy stoop and rises with a grin.

reply.summary: Rnire is a blue-eyed lawyer who rose to lead a young republic. Plain-spoken and wary, this officeholder spends his term handling quarrels between rival states.

feats.scene: Rnire signs a decree and sets a long argument to rest.
Rnire rides out a wagon jolt on a rough road without complaint.

reply.summary: Tiasilvar is a legendary army sergeant who leads a battered squad through endless campaigns. Deadly with a submachine gun and fists, this soldier even fought on after devastating injury.

feats.scene: Tiasilvar downs two diving aircraft with a single drum of ammunition.
Tiasilvar rises from a collapsed trench after shells flatten it.

reply.summary: Rnlome is a scholar of lights in the sky who gained psychic powers from a strange drug. Once a foe, this redeemed thinker weaves illusions and reads minds, though his thoughts can be steered by implants.

feats.scene: Rnlome projects a vivid illusion of a charging beast that sends a squad running.
Rnlome shakes off a blow from a rifle stock and keeps focusing.

reply.summary: Seonan is a freckled, cheerful cousin of a famous pair of wizard-granted siblings. Warm and quick-witted, this girl tags along on their adventures and cheers loudest.

feats.scene: Seonan throws a pillow across a bedroom and hits her target.
Seonan tumbles off a swing and bounces up laughing.

reply.summary: Saustuna is a polite service machine in a hidden hideout that blends a cave with a frozen stronghold. Part servant and part caped figure, this robot butler hovers nervously and serves hot drinks to dangerous masters.

feats.scene: Saustuna swats a hostile drone out of the air with a metal arm.
Saustuna is thrown into a steel wall and reboots with a dented cape.

reply.summary: Ntosa is a postal worker whose every sleep carries him between two cities and two lives. Driven mad by experiments, this courier turned into a reality-warping being who believes every world is his own dream.

feats.scene: Ntosa rewrites the shape of a whole crowd of parallel worlds with a single shout.
Ntosa stands unharmed as an army of hostile heroes pour their strongest strikes into him.

reply.summary: Lormi is a red-haired adventurer who died but wanders both the land of the living and the dead as a ghost. Unseen and unable to be touched, this spirit can slip into bodies and fight with a trained fist.

feats.scene: Lormi slips into a guard and flings him over a counter.
Lormi drifts through a collapsing wall and takes no hurt.

reply.summary: Tortel is a prankish youth who can stretch and scrunch his features and in time his entire body. Selfish but harmless, this shapeshifter assumes weird alien shapes and slips out of prison in a mass escape.

feats.scene: Tortel morphs a fist into a huge mallet and thumps a guard's helmet.
Tortel squeezes between bars and survives a hard cell door slam.

reply.summary: Sarrusllu is a grey-haired, big-shouldered beat cop with decades on the force and a hot temper. Loyal to his old mentor's family, this officer raises an orphan and keeps showing up for tough cases.

feats.scene: Sarrusllu shoulders a locked door off its frame during a raid.
Sarrusllu absorbs a brawler's blows and keeps arresting him.

reply.summary: Torronni is a bankrupt attorney who volunteered for a drug trial, died on the table and came back with golden skin. Desperate and vengeful, this transformed man now strikes at those who thought him gone.

feats.scene: Torronni punches a steel shutter off a storefront.
Torronni stands up from a hail of pistol rounds without a mark.

reply.summary: Resnumvas is an industrialist and pilot who secretly built a wingless jet suit and took to the skies as a hero. Charming and impulsive, this flyer served in an elite team and annoyed its other members.

feats.scene: Resnumvas dive-bombs an invading craft and tears a fin off it.
Resnumvas crashes through a pavilion roof and stands up cursing.
Resnumvas streaks above the skyline at full thrust.

reply.summary: Nauval is a young boy with a limp, part of a foster family that includes a secret champion. Worrying and kind, this child never guesses that his brother flies off to fight invaders.

feats.scene: Nauval throws a ball across a yard and hits the fence.
Nauval slips on a staircase and catches the rail.

reply.summary: Tiriano is a boy who shares a wizard's blessing with five other children and receives the power of the king of the sky. When all six shout the word together, this hero merges into a scarred giant champion.

feats.scene: Tiriano hurls a lightning-wrapped boulder that levels a freight depot.
Tiriano takes a villain's strongest blow and merely skids across the pavement.

reply.summary: Liestnum is a foster kid who receives a share of a champion's power in a grim alternate scenario. Together with his siblings, this young hero forms a defending army that throws lightning, flies and punches hard.

feats.scene: Liestnum calls down a lightning bolt that shatters a bridge pylon.
Liestnum is blasted by a rampaging foe and shakes it off.
Liestnum streaks across a city skyline faster than sound.

reply.summary: Lesnitor is a cheerful teen who speaks a magic word and becomes a young champion in a cartoon world of team-ups. Blue-eyed and boyish, this junior hero joins grown-up allies for lively adventures.

feats.scene: Lesnitor smashes a runaway robot's torso with one thunderous punch.
Lesnitor catches a toppling statue and holds it up.

reply.summary: Cineonan is a comic-loving, fidgety boy who is the adoptive younger brother of a wizard's champion. Excitable and brave, this schoolboy turns into a heroic figure in a playful animated world.

feats.scene: Cineonan hurls a giant pumpkin that knocks over a cardboard villain.
Cineonan crashes through a cardboard wall and pops up smiling.

reply.summary: Ntiva is a war-obsessed former soldier who runs a private army from a bunker deep beneath an island city. Masked as a blood-red commander, this schemer abducts a hero's friend to learn the shape of the next global conflict.

feats.scene: Ntiva orders a cache of demolition charges blown and caves in a whole tunnel.
Ntiva is flung across his command room by a trained fighter.

reply.summary: Esiumes is a bald wheelman and fighter trained by a master of the ancient arts. Always behind a steering wheel, this driver works for a criminal network and turns tight alleys into racetracks.

feats.scene: Esiumes lands a spinning kick on a bodyguard and sends him through a window.
Esiumes absorbs a sideswipe in a tight chase and keeps his hands on the wheel.
Esiumes floors the pedal on a straight avenue with sirens behind him.

reply.summary: Lanlire is a nimble sailor who crossed an ocean aboard a warship and joined a band of frontier scouts. Light on his feet and lively with a joke, this fighter is the most agile man in the ranks.

feats.scene: Lanlire swings from a rigging rope and kicks a musket from a redcoat's hands.
Lanlire tumbles down a muddy slope and springs up unhurt.
Lanlire sprints across a deck and leaps the rail.

reply.summary: Conel is a pair of identical twin brothers born joined and split by a strange biology of their homeworld. Fighting beautifully together yet bickering constantly, these two serve as part-time reserves of a heroic order.

feats.scene: Conel combines both bodies and heaves a toppled girder off a trapped crew.
Conel takes a blast from an invader's cannon and splits apart unharmed.

reply.summary: Miestal is a radiant goddess of love who rules a meadow of the afterlife and welcomes half of the fallen warriors there. Ageless and graceful, this deity rides a chariot drawn by cats and shares a hall with her twin.

feats.scene: Miestal throws a single glance at a besieging army and melts its resolve and its weapons.
Miestal stands unscathed in the heart of a crashing storm of thunder.

reply.summary: Eooriam is a fierce war goddess and captain of a corps of battle-maidens who ride flying horses. Skilled with axe and blade and ageless in body, this immortal warrior sneers at the helpless prayers of her enemies.

feats.scene: Eooriam cleaves a siege tower in half with one swing of a triple-headed axe.
Eooriam stands through a rain of siege stones with no wound.

reply.summary: Stariren is a cheerful, round-bellied cleric who fights alongside forest outlaws against a grasping lord. Handy with a long staff and a sword, this monk trains hounds and quotes scripture between blows.

feats.scene: Stariren spins a quarterstaff and cracks three guards' helmets in a single sweep.
Stariren takes a mailed fist to the jaw and answers with a hymn.

reply.summary: Tirnniu is a wasted, blue-skinned addict transformed into a crackling being of living electricity. Driven by cravings, this wanderer flies on his own charge and fears a good dousing.

feats.scene: Tirnniu blasts a transformer and blacks out a block of the beach.
Tirnniu is hit by a heavy truck and flickers but keeps moving.

reply.summary: Vascesser is a towering, yellow-skinned alien hybrid abandoned as an infant and raised by forest creatures. Gentle but hunted, this wanderer is bound to a genie-like being and became an uneasy ally of a young team.

feats.scene: Vascesser rips a lab door from its frame and hurls it across a hangar.
Vascesser takes a volley from captors' weapons and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Tauau is an infant amphibian prince swollen to giant size by dark enchantment in a land of gems. Babyish and easily swayed by bottles, this enormous toddler stomps mightily without understanding why.

feats.scene: Tauau stomps a fortress rampart and cracks it from top to bottom.
Tauau shrugs off a barrage of siege bolts and burps.

reply.summary: Tesveoor is a bullied former recruit who dresses as an amphibian to murder officers during a street festival. Cowardly and vengeful, this killer carries a two-pronged spear and a hose full of water.

feats.scene: Tesveoor drives a bident through a heavy oak door and pins a commander behind it.
Tesveoor takes a spear in the chest and dies.

reply.summary: Teveool is a hopeful teen who tried out for a team of heroes with a modest talent for holding his breath. Cheerful and earnest, this applicant never makes the cut but never stops trying.

feats.scene: Teveool throws a lifebuoy across a pool and drops it beside a swimmer.
Teveool stays submerged in a fountain for a staggering three minutes.

reply.summary: Laneonium is a headline-obsessed rogue who strikes under a newsprint mask and vanishes into the crowd. Minor and short-lived, this troublemaker lasted a single bold outing against a shape-shifting hero.

feats.scene: Laneonium swings a heavy roll of paper at a security guard and drops him.
Laneonium tumbles across a press floor and shakes off the ink.

reply.summary: Seernore is a blue-haired woman from a mirror-world who chills the air around her with a touch. Merciless and cool, this agent of a villainous syndicate freezes opponents solid.

feats.scene: Seernore breathes out a glacial gust that encases a ferry pier in ice.
Seernore walks through a blast of flame with only frost on her sleeves.

reply.summary: Tumniveo is a yellow-eyed, hot-blooded criminal who controls open flame with a thought. Escaped from an underground cell, this firebug lights up streets alongside other freed prisoners.

feats.scene: Tumniveo sets a parked delivery truck ablaze with one shout and a wave.
Tumniveo walks through a blazing storefront without scorching.

reply.summary: Saesrau is a crime lord who runs the district's underworld with a doctor's knowledge of poisons and sleep. Cunning and cruel, this boss was jailed, broke out and met his end after a bold double cross.

feats.scene: Saesrau stabs a needle into a captive's arm and induces a trance.
Saesrau shrugs off a street fight and bows out with a sneer.

reply.summary: Riantniu is a white-haired woman with ebony skin whose kiss makes living flesh rot away in seconds. Spiteful and cold, this jailbreaker leaves nothing but dust in her wake.

feats.scene: Riantniu kisses a guard's cheek and he withers to dust in moments.
Riantniu is thrown into a cell wall and shakes herself clean.

reply.summary: Vater is a failed strip artist who invented a ray that pulls inked figures into the real world. Bitter and gifted in science, this cartoonist sent flat villains out to loot until he learned that his own creations never came alive.

feats.scene: Vater turns his ray on a sketch of a dragon and the beast torches a bank vault.
Vater is knocked out cold by a strong fist in his workshop.

reply.summary: Tontasrn is a green-skinned dream-eating fiend who crouches at the edge of sleepers' minds. Feeding on terror, this nightmare lord twists gentle dreams into screams, and a famous painting inspired his image.

feats.scene: Tontasrn pulls an entire dormitory into a single shared nightmare of falling.
Tontasrn takes a spell squarely and re-forms from smoke and dread.

reply.summary: Inreova is a red-eyed, hairless fiend with emerald skin who stalks the borderlands of dreams. Fed by fear, this monster turns sweet slumber into dread and relishes every scream.

feats.scene: Inreova drags a whole sleeping neighbourhood into a nightmare that leaves them gasping.
Inreova shrugs off a blaze of white light and creeps back from the shadows.

reply.summary: Rauveveo is a green goldfish who is a beloved companion to a young sea-prince. Round-eyed and calm, this small swimmer visits a strange reality to meet his mirror twin.

feats.scene: Rauveveo flicks his tail and sends a ripple across a bowl.
Rauveveo bobs through a splashy tank toss without harm.

reply.summary: Oreter is a grey pet mouse that gained brawn and invulnerability after a lab ray misfired. Nearly human height on his hind legs, this rodent wears a hero costume and lifts a piano overhead.

feats.scene: Oreter lifts a grand piano overhead and carries it across a parlour.
Oreter picks up red-hot coals and shows no sign of pain.

reply.summary: Stist is a grey-and-white mouse who borrowed a slice of a hero-hound's gifts when an evil device drained them. Proud of the cape and mask he wears, this rodent flies, runs fast, blasts heat and punches far above his size.

feats.scene: Stist blows a column of heat at a villain's war machine and melts its plating.
Stist bounces off a crashing walker and squeaks defiantly.
Stist rockets over a rooftop skyline ahead of a speeding drone.
